name: extract_firmware
description: Extract caller-selected firmware bytes with Unblob 26.6.x (verified with 26.6.4) into an absent output directory. Returns verified child paths/digests, task derivations, unknown chunks, extraction diagnostics and explicit extraction_gaps rows naming unextracted regions, missing extractor dependencies and a continuation_id referencing shared extraction_continuations recovery instructions. Preserves the default sandbox; publishes regular files only. Linux, caller-supplied tool, format-specific extractors and util-linux prlimit required. No mounts or extracted-code execution. Select a returned native file with open_binary for Ghidra analysis; decompressed offsets are not original-file addresses.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Analysis wall-clock budget in milliseconds (default 120000), from tool resolution through inspection and its final workspace cleanup, or extraction through inventory. Excludes queue admission and extraction publication. Does not raise fixed CPU, memory or byte limits.

max_depth.description: Extraction depth; reaching it yields partial analysis

max_output_bytes.description: Staging file-byte budget, checked during extraction; transient overshoot is possible

max_output_files.description: Staging entry budget, including directories and links

output_directory.description: Absolute, absent output directory; parent must exist

path.description: Absolute local firmware file; never executed. Relative paths are rejected.

publication_timeout_ms.description: Publication and final cleanup budget in milliseconds, started after extraction and inventory; increase for a slow destination

range.description: Explicit file-byte interval; omit to extract the whole file
